routes.description: Displays the BooksPage where users can view all available books.
Displays the AddBookPage for adding a new book with the specified title and book ID.
Displays the CartPage where users can view and manage their selected books in the cart.
Displays the AdminBooksPage for managing books (CRUD operations).
Fetches a paginated list of books. Optional query parameters include 'pageSize', 'pageNum', and 'category'.
Fetches a distinct list of book categories.
Adds a new book to the database. Expects a JSON payload matching the Book model.
Updates the details of an existing book. Requires a book ID as a URL parameter and a JSON payload.
Deletes a book from the database. Requires a book ID as a URL parameter.
